description: Free sample. Before a coding agent runs a shell command, ask whether to allow, review or block it: root deletion, download and run, privilege escalation, secret exfiltration. Pass the human intent when you know it. Not a sandbox: it reads the command, it does not run it.

command.description: The shell command the agent wants to run.

intent.description: Optional. What the human asked the agent to do.

name: verdict_command_gate
title: Shell command gate
